data.description: You can use DEX instead of STR for attack and damage rolls with Unarmed Strikes and Monk Weapons, and your Unarmed Strikes deal a Martial Arts die of damage (1d6 at level 1, scaling to 1d12 at level 17). When you take the Attack action, you can make one Unarmed Strike as a Bonus Action.
data.note: Use DEX (instead of STR) for attack and damage rolls of your Unarmed Strikes and Monk Weapons. Martial Arts die: 1d6 (L1), 1d8 (L5), 1d10 (L11), 1d12 (L17). When you take the Attack action on your turn, you can make one Unarmed Strike as a Bonus Action. Monk Weapons = Simple Melee weapons + Shortsword + any other weapon you choose with the Monk property.

activities.name: Martial Arts: Unarmed Strike (Bonus)
activities.note: Immediately after the Attack action with an Unarmed Strike or Monk Weapon, make one Unarmed Strike as a Bonus Action. Die scales: 1d6 (L1-4), 1d8 (L5-10), 1d10 (L11-16), 1d12 (L17-20).

data.description: While you are not wearing armor or wielding a shield, your AC equals 10 + your Dexterity modifier + your Wisdom modifier.

You have a pool of Focus Points equal to your Monk level, which you spend to fuel features like Flurry of Blows, Patient Defense, Step of the Wind, and Stunning Strike. You regain all spent Focus Points when you finish a Short or Long Rest.
data.note: Focus Points pool: equal to your Monk level. Spent by various features (Flurry of Blows, Patient Defense, Step of the Wind, Stunning Strike, and subclass features). Recovers on a Short or Long Rest. v0 surfaces a single resource pool tagged per-short-rest; activities that spend focus reference this pool narratively.

data.description: Spend 1 Focus Point as a Bonus Action to take the Disengage or Dash action; your jump distance is also doubled for the turn.

activities.name: Step of the Wind
activities.note: Spend 1 Focus Point to take the Disengage or Dash action as a Bonus Action; jump distance is doubled for the turn. v0 doesn't deduct the focus point automatically — surface as a narrative note.

data.description: Take the Disengage action as a Bonus Action for free, or spend 1 Focus Point to take both the Disengage and Dodge actions as a single Bonus Action.

activities.name: Patient Defense
activities.note: Take the Disengage action as a Bonus Action (free), or spend 1 Focus Point to take both the Disengage and Dodge actions as a single Bonus Action. v0 doesn't deduct the focus point automatically.

data.description: Immediately after taking the Attack action, spend 1 Focus Point to make two Unarmed Strikes as a Bonus Action (three strikes at level 10). Each strike deals your Martial Arts die in damage.

activities.name: Flurry of Blows
activities.note: Immediately after the Attack action, spend 1 Focus Point to make two Unarmed Strikes as a Bonus Action (this activity models one of the two strikes; engine doesn't multi-target a single activity). Number of strikes increases to 3 at L10. Damage die scales with monk level: 1d6 (L1-4), 1d8 (L5-10), 1d10 (L11-16), 1d12 (L17-20).

data.description: Your speed increases by 10 feet while you are not wearing armor or wielding a shield. This bonus grows as you gain Monk levels, reaching +30 feet at level 18.
data.note: Speed bonus scales by monk level (table above). SRD: only when not wearing armor or holding a shield — engine cannot detect equipment state, applies unconditionally.

data.description: Choose a Monk subclass — your Warrior tradition that grants you additional features at levels 3, 6, 11, and 17.
data.note: Placeholder for subclass selection (Warrior of the Open Hand, Shadow, Elements, Mercy in 2024). The chosen subclass slug lives on character.classes[].subclass.

data.description: Reaction: when a melee or ranged weapon attack hits you, reduce the damage by 1d10 + your Dexterity modifier + your Monk level. If you reduce the damage to 0, you can spend 1 Focus Point to redirect the force as a ranged attack against the original attacker.
data.note: When an attack roll hits you with a Bludgeoning, Piercing, or Slashing attack (melee or ranged), use your Reaction to reduce the damage by 1d10 + your DEX modifier + your Monk level. If the damage is reduced to 0, you can spend 1 Focus Point to redirect some of the attack's force: make a ranged attack with a thrown weapon or unarmed strike.

data.description: Once per turn, when you hit a creature with a Monk Weapon or Unarmed Strike, spend 1 Focus Point to force the target to make a CON saving throw against your Monk spell save DC. On a failure, the target has the Stunned condition until the end of your next turn.
data.note: Once per turn, when you hit a creature with a Monk Weapon or Unarmed Strike, spend 1 Focus Point to force a CON saving throw against your Monk spell save DC (8 + PB + WIS). On a fail, the target has the Stunned condition until the end of your next turn. v0 doesn't deduct the focus point or enforce the once-per-turn cap automatically; surfaces as a tagged action-modifier toggle.
